profile: node permutation invariance: a property required of graph neural networks (GNNs) so that learned representations (embeddings) do not depend on the indexing or ordering of graph nodes. This ensures that the same graph, regardless of how its nodes are labeled or permuted, yields the same embedding, making the model's output invariant to node permutations.
